name: JVM Heap %
programText:
a = data('jvm_memory_bytes_used', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'schemaregistry') and filter('area', 'heap') and filter('service.instance.id', 'schemaregistry-0')).sum()
b = data('jvm_memory_bytes_max', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'schemaregistry') and filter('area', 'heap') and filter('service.instance.id', 'schemaregistry-0')).sum()
(a/b*100).publish(label='JVM Heap %')
